raw.verdict: B and D both grounded their answers in the radar call. Only B noticed that half of the 'private credit' papers concern bank credit to the private sector rather than private credit markets, which shows how thin the real literature is. B also quantified the gap between research and news. D was faithful to the data but had a shallower trend and only one chart. A and C answered from memory: C was honestly labelled but answered with AUM rather than research measures, and A cited unresolvable identifiers.
